instruction: In VLC, set the maximum volume to 200% and turn off the expanding background cone animation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VLC config file at /home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc, which is where VLC persists preferences after save.
Both config keys (qt-max-volume and qt-bgcone-expands) match VLC's actual vlcrc key names for the Qt interface settings.
Default values (qt_max_volume='125', qt_bgcone_expands='1') represent VLC's initial state, ensuring the initial state fails both checks — good negative-control resistance.
Getter correctly skips commented (#) and empty lines, only reading explicitly set values.
Metric uses str() comparison for both values: str(200)='200' vs parsed string from file, and '0' vs parsed string — correct for VLC config format.
Partial credit (0.5+0.5) correctly maps to the two independent sub-goals in the instruction.
Expected values (200, '0') directly correspond to the instruction requirements: 200% max volume and cone animation off.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor robustness improvement: trim whitespace from parsed values (line.split('=', 1)[-1].strip() is already used — good), but also consider stripping the key side in case VLC writes 'qt-max-volume = 200' with spaces around '='.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated VLC advanced preferences to the Qt interface panel, changed max volume from 125 to 200, and saved. The 'Expanding background cone or art' checkbox was visible and checked in the same Qt interface panel.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC advanced preferences tree, edit numeric fields, and toggle checkboxes in the Qt interface settings panel.
metadata.explanation: Chain task: (1) set qt-max-volume=200 in vlcrc (0.5 pts), (2) disable expanding cone animation qt-bgcone-expands=0 (0.5 pts). Both settings are in the Qt interface panel. Initial state (125, expanding cone enabled) does not pass either check.
metadata.task_rationale: Composition: chains the solved max-volume goal with disabling the expanding cone animation — a distinct checkbox in the same Qt preferences panel, requiring the agent to handle two edits in one pass.
